children: Banana Ball Championship League owner Jesse Cole told Bloomberg This Weekend that the Savannah Bananas have built a baseball experience around faster games, elaborate entertainment and affordable tickets, creating a wait list of roughly 5 million fans.

Cole said the league plans to keep expanding its audience in the US and internationally while maintaining its fans-first model, including $35 tickets without added fees and free game streams on YouTube.

title: Banana Ball League Expands Nationwide as Savannah Bananas Draw 5 Million-Name Wait List
